settings.heading: One tool for the emergency start and the diagnosis.
settings.body: Combines a 700A starting / 1,500A peak 12V jump starter with a built-in OBD2 scanner, digital 1% charge readout, 36W USB-A output, and 3-mode LED light.
settings.image_alt: SuntNeew OJ02 2-in-1 jump starter and OBD2 scanner kit
settings.support_text: 8,000mAh / 29.6Wh net 450g (0.99 lb) unit in a 160 × 90 × 40 mm body.

settings.heading: Read the vehicle before you decide what it needs.
settings.body: Plug in the supplied OBD2 cable to read and clear fault codes, inspect live data streams, check I/M emission readiness, and review vehicle telemetry across 9 protocols and 12 languages.
settings.image_alt: SuntNeew OJ02 OBD2 diagnostic screen connected to a car
settings.support_text: Covers 9 diagnostic modes for OBD2-compliant 12V vehicles.

settings.heading: Connect, check the indicator, start, then disconnect.
settings.body: Rated for compatible 12V vehicles up to 6.0L gasoline or 3.0L diesel using heavy 10AWG, 50 cm EC5 smart clamps with visual and audible polarity protection.
settings.image_alt: SuntNeew OJ02 connected to 12V car battery with EC5 smart clamps
settings.support_text: Always keep OJ02 above 50% charge before attempting a jump start.

settings.heading: 1% charge precision, 36W USB-A & 3 LED emergency modes.
settings.body: Read exact remaining battery down to 1%, recharge phones at 5V/3A, 9V/3A, or 12V/3A (up to 36W max), and signal safely at night with steady, warning flash, and SOS modes.
settings.image_alt: SuntNeew OJ02 screen readout and OBD2 diagnostic menu

settings.question: Which vehicles is OJ02 designed to support?
settings.answer: OJ02 is for compatible 12V vehicles, with a stated reference of up to 6.0L gasoline or 3.0L diesel engines. Confirm the vehicle, battery condition and manual before use.

settings.question: What do the 700A and 1,500A figures mean?
settings.answer: OJ02 is specified with 700A starting current and 1,500A peak current. Actual results vary with vehicle type, battery condition, engine condition and temperature.

settings.question: What can the OBD2 function do?
settings.answer: OJ02 provides 9 diagnostic functions, including reading and clearing fault codes, live data, I/M readiness and supported sensor checks. It supports 9 major protocols and 12 languages; vehicle compatibility should be confirmed before use.

settings.question: What does the smart clamp include?
settings.answer: The EC5 clamp uses a 10AWG, 50cm cable with status lights and audible guidance. Connect red to positive and black to negative, then follow the indicator and manual sequence.

settings.question: Can OJ02 charge a phone or small device?
settings.answer: Yes. The USB output supports 5V/3A, 9V/3A and 12V/3A, up to 36W maximum for compatible devices.

settings.question: What light modes does OJ02 have?
settings.answer: The built-in LED supports steady illumination, red warning flashes and SOS signaling for roadside and outdoor emergencies.
